title: JeffersonWM widget source pause and daily discovery checkpoint
content:
This pass explored a richer JeffersonWM homepage widget: more editorial and no-auth discovery sources, better source-health thinking, Pacific-day timing, and a wider surface for future terminology and image-title feeds.

What worked:

  • The richer architecture held up: mixed outside sources could be normalized into the same homepage widget without breaking the existing direction.
  • Pacific-day cadence is the right model: the widget should change on the JeffersonWM schedule at midnight Pacific instead of drifting with provider release timing.
  • The work was left reversible: the broader source system was paused by commenting it out cleanly, not by deleting it.

What did not hold up as the default homepage experience:

  • The extended list felt too busy: the longer discovery surface added more visual density than the home page currently wants.
  • Some outside sources are better treated as optional: they make sense as future enrichments, but not as the always-on default row right now.

The final rollback was a preference decision, not a failure. The end state keeps only Merriam-Webster, Wiktionary, Dictionary.com, Vocabulary.com, and the typeface line active, while the larger discovery/photo/terminology groundwork stays commented and ready for a later return.
